metadata.title: Platform DNS Resolution and Recursion

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing deterministic, controlled DNS name resolution within the trusted platform.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Recursive DNS resolvers, forwarding behavior, and resolution path control.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern controlling how DNS resolution is performed without embedding naming semantics or exposure decisions.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: DNS resolution and recursion inherit baseline trust assumptions defined in Platform DNS Core.

metadata.remarks: Platform DNS Resolution and Recursion defines how names are resolved within the trusted environment. It governs recursive behavior, forwarding paths, and upstream dependencies to ensure resolution is deterministic, controlled, and free from unintended delegation.

components.title: DNS Recursive Resolution
components.description: Controls the use of recursive DNS resolution within the platform.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Network service discovery and abuse through uncontrolled or open DNS recursion.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Restriction of recursive resolution to authorized clients and scopes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recursive resolution is restricted to authorized systems within defined trust boundaries.

components.title: DNS Forwarding Control
components.description: Governs forwarding of DNS queries to upstream resolvers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of implicit trust in upstream DNS resolution dependencies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit control of resolution paths and upstream dependencies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Upstream resolution dependencies are explicitly defined and governed.
